in_hebrew.long_meaning: One who is joyful, exuberant, or boisterous.

in_greek.name: Κιππιος
in_greek.long_meaning: A name derived from the Greek word 'κιππος' meaning 'cup' or 'vessel'. The name Kippos was given to those who carried the water from the well to the tabernacle or temple. Over time, the name evolved to Kippie, which has a more cheerful and joyful connotation.

in_latin.name: Cippus
in_latin.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'cippus', meaning 'cup' or 'vessel'. The name was originally given to those who carried water from the well to the Roman temples.
